name: mf-all
description: Module Federation 2.0 playground: 7 framework apps (Vue, React, Angular, Svelte, Solid, Preact, Lit), each hosting all 7 widgets

scripts.dev: concurrently -kn vue,react,angular,svelte,solid,preact,lit,alpine,jquery -c cyan,blue,red,orange,green,magenta,yellow,gray,brightBlue "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-vue dev" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-react dev" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-angular dev" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-svelte dev" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-solid dev" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-preact dev" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-lit dev" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-alpine dev" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-jquery dev"
scripts.preview: concurrently -kn vue,react,angular,svelte,solid,preact,lit,alpine,jquery -c cyan,blue,red,orange,green,magenta,yellow,gray,brightBlue "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-vue preview" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-react preview" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-angular preview" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-svelte preview" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-solid preview" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-preact preview" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-lit preview" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-alpine preview" "pnpm --filter @mf-all/app-jquery preview"
